name: Drape
author: Erin Carter
description: Heavy silk fills the frame in smooth vertical folds, lit with analytic normals so every crest carries a luminous specular sheen while valleys fall to near-black. Crest highlights blend the palette by horizontal position so neighbouring folds glow in different restrained hues, and the cloth sways slowly as if hung at an open window.

params.label: Fold width
params.effect: CSS-pixel width of one silk fold; smaller packs more, narrower folds with tighter highlight ridges, larger gives a few broad cinematic folds.

params.label: Sway speed
params.effect: Scales how fast fold positions lean and wrinkles drift, from near-still hanging cloth to a steady draught.

params.label: Sheen
params.effect: Strength and tightness of the specular crest highlights, from matte wool at the low end to liquid silk at the high end.
